tests.name: New user can sign up and lands on a funded dashboard
tests.summary:
Created an account using the name Kane Tester, email kanew9semf@mlyfo.app, and username kanew9semf.
Confirmed that @kanew9semf was available before completing registration.
Entered the password and created the account successfully.
Reached the welcome page for Kane, where the wallet balance displayed $500.00.

tests.name: New user can sign up and lands on a funded dashboard
tests.summary:
Completed the requested registration using the name Kane Tester, email kanew9s8wt@mlyfo.app, and username kanew9s8wt.
Confirmed that @kanew9s8wt was available, then entered the password and created the account.
The new account opened successfully with the heading “Welcome, Kane” and a wallet balance of $500.00.

tests.name: Split a $236 bill four ways and get a link per person
tests.summary:
Created the requested split for “Kane dinner w9s6pm” with a total of $236 and participants zoya, kabir, and sofia.
Confirmed the split was divided among 4 people at $59.00 each.
Created the split and payment links successfully; it is listed as “1 of 4 paid.”
Confirmed that zoya, kabir, and sofia each have a $59.00 amount and a Copy link button.

tests.name: Shield blocks a look-alike of a saved contact's address
tests.summary:
You asked to sign in and check the supplied wallet address on the Shield page.
The Sign in button was selected, then the Shield page was opened.
The provided address was entered and checked.
The result marked the address as “Blocked” and said it looks like Ada’s saved address but is not.

tests.name: Shield blocks a look-alike of a saved contact's address
tests.summary:
Checked the requested cryptocurrency address on the Shield page.
Entered the provided address and selected “Check address.”
The result marked the address as “Blocked” and warned that it looks like Ada’s saved address but is not.

tests.name: A payment over the spend limit waits for password confirmation
tests.summary:
Entered the requested payment message, “pay @ada 150 for rent.”
Selected the option to pay $150.00 to @ada and reviewed the confirmation, including the per-payment limit notice.
Entered the provided password and confirmed the payment.
The payment was completed successfully, with the page confirming: “Sent $150.00 to @ada.”

tests.name: Shield flags a fake Phantom airdrop link as dangerous
tests.summary:
You asked to check the link https://phantorn-airdrop.app/claim.
Entered the link and selected Quick check.
The scan marked the link as Dangerous and explained that the address imitates Phantom.

tests.name: Shield flags a fake Phantom airdrop link as dangerous
tests.summary:
Entered the requested website address into the link checker.
Ran a quick check on the link.
The scan marked the link as Dangerous and listed that the address imitates Phantom.

tests.name: Shield refuses to save a look-alike of a saved person
tests.summary:
Attempted to add a person named “Ada new” with the provided wallet address.
Saved the person form on the People page.
The page reported that the address was not saved because it looked like Ada’s saved address.
“Ada new” was not added to the list of people.

tests.name: Paying a name that is both a saved person and another user asks who you meant
tests.summary:
Requested a $5 coffee payment to Semi by entering “pay semi 5 for coffee.”
Selected “Pay $5.00,” then chose “Your contact Semi” when asked which Semi was intended.
The payment was completed, and the page confirmed “Sent $5.00 to Semi.”

tests.name: A payment gives a receipt with an ID and a public receipt page
tests.summary:
Opened the Receipt link from Recent activity as requested.
The receipt page confirmed a $10.00 payment to @kabir.
The receipt displayed ID MLY-7PDM-4GWA, which starts with “MLY-”.

tests.name: A payment gives a receipt with an ID and a public receipt page
tests.summary:
Opened the Receipt link from Recent activity.
The receipt page confirmed a $10.00 payment to @kabir.
The receipt ID shown was MLY-3GDZ-8HTX, which begins with “MLY-”.

tests.name: The Android keyboard hands a copied address to Shield
tests.summary:
You asked to sign in and open the Shield address-check page for the provided address.
The Shield page opened with the supplied address already entered in the address field.
The check result marked the address as “Blocked” and warned that it looks like Ada’s saved address but is not.

tests.name: The Android keyboard hands a copied address to Shield
tests.summary:
You asked to sign in and check the provided wallet address on the Shield page.
The Shield page opened with AdaK9zXw2LmQ8rTvB3nYc7HsP4kJe6FgD1oWu5Ra2Fx entered in the address field.
The check completed with a “Blocked” result, warning that it looks like Ada’s saved address but is not; its first and last four characters match while the middle differs.

tests.name: Shield blocks a look-alike of a saved Ethereum and Base address
tests.summary:
You asked to sign in and check the specified wallet address on Mlyfo.
The address was opened in the Shield checker and remained filled in the address field.
The check result marked the address as “Blocked,” warned that it resembles Ada (Base)’s saved address but is not the same address, and showed the “Ethereum · Base” network badge.

tests.name: Shield blocks a look-alike of a saved Ethereum and Base address
tests.summary:
You asked to sign in and check the specified wallet address.
The specified address was opened in the address checker.
The address field contained 0x7a3f9cE5b801Dd3fA7426C9e0B1f8a5d3e27c4b9.
The result was Blocked and warned that it looks like Ada (Base)’s saved address but is not.
The result identified the network as Ethereum · Base.

tests.name: The Android page offers the app install and a safe keyboard download
tests.summary:
Opened the Mlyfo manifest page as requested.
Confirmed the page includes the “Mlyfo on your Android phone” heading, a “Download the keyboard” button, Chrome installation guidance, and the stated keyboard privacy information.
Confirmed the download-check section displays a SHA-256 fingerprint.
Confirmed the manifest shows the app name “Mlyfo” with display mode “standalone”.

tests.name: The Android page offers the app install and a safe keyboard download
tests.summary:
Opened the Mlyfo manifest page as requested.
Confirmed the page includes the “Mlyfo on your Android phone” heading, a “Download the keyboard” button, Chrome installation guidance, and the stated privacy information.
Confirmed the “Check your download” section displays a SHA-256 fingerprint.
The manifest displays the app name “Mlyfo” with the display mode set to “standalone”.
